# Change.org

> Global petition platform where people start, support, and win campaigns for social and political change.

Change.org helps individuals and communities create petitions, gather signatures, mobilize supporters, and pressure decision-makers. The platform also publishes campaign guidance, success stories, and issue-based petition discovery across many countries and languages.

## Core Platform
- [Homepage](https://www.change.org/): Main entry point for discovering petitions, campaigns, and platform features.
- [Start a petition](https://www.change.org/start-a-petition): Petition creation flow for launching a new public campaign.
- [Explore petitions](https://www.change.org/petitions): Browse active petitions across issues, places, and trending topics.
- [Victory stories](https://www.change.org/victories): Collection of successful campaigns and petition wins from the community.
- [Impact stories](https://www.change.org/impact-stories): Editorial stories showing how petition campaigns achieved real-world outcomes.
- [Decision makers](https://www.change.org/decision-makers): Directory and discovery area for public figures and institutions targeted by petitions.

## Petition Guides
- [Petition Guides](https://www.change.org/petition-guides): Central hub for practical advice on building and growing effective petitions.
- [Create a petition](https://www.change.org/petition-guides/create-a-petition): Guide to writing a clear, compelling petition people will support.
- [Share your petition](https://www.change.org/petition-guides/share-your-petition): Tactics for distributing petitions and increasing signature growth.
- [Build momentum](https://www.change.org/petition-guides/build-momentum): Advice for sustaining attention and escalating pressure during a campaign.
- [Engage decision makers](https://www.change.org/petition-guides/engage-decision-makers): Guidance on identifying and influencing the people who can act.
- [Media outreach](https://www.change.org/petition-guides/media): Tips for contacting journalists and earning coverage for a cause.

## Success and Impact
- [Ban water beads now](https://www.change.org/impact-stories/ban-water-beads-now): Story of a campaign pushing major retailers and policymakers to act.
- [Demand justice for victims and pass Lorenso's Law](https://www.change.org/impact-stories/reform-prop-57-demand-justice-for-victims-and-pass-lorenso-s-law): Campaign story focused on criminal justice reform and victims’ rights.
- [Clean up the Santa Susana Field Lab](https://www.change.org/impact-stories/no-more-kids-with-cancer-clean-up-the-santa-susana-field-lab): Story about environmental health advocacy and community pressure.
- [Release Virgilio Aguilar Mendez immediately](https://www.change.org/impact-stories/release-virgilio-aguilar-mendez-immediately): Example of community organizing around detention and legal justice.
- [Victories](https://www.change.org/victories): Broader archive of successful petitions and campaign outcomes.

## Browse by Issue
- [Animal rights petitions](https://www.change.org/petitions?selectedCategory=animal-rights): Petitions related to animal welfare, protection, and conservation issues.
- [Education petitions](https://www.change.org/petitions?selectedCategory=education): Campaigns about schools, students, curriculum, and education policy.
- [Environment petitions](https://www.change.org/petitions?selectedCategory=environment): Petitions focused on climate, pollution, conservation, and environmental justice.
- [Health petitions](https://www.change.org/petitions?selectedCategory=health): Campaigns involving healthcare access, safety, and public health concerns.
- [Human rights petitions](https://www.change.org/petitions?selectedCategory=human-rights): Petitions addressing civil liberties, equality, and human dignity.
- [Justice petitions](https://www.change.org/petitions?selectedCategory=justice): Campaigns about policing, courts, sentencing, and legal accountability.
- [Politics petitions](https://www.change.org/petitions?selectedCategory=politics): Petitions concerning government decisions, elections, and public policy.
- [Women’s rights petitions](https://www.change.org/petitions?selectedCategory=womens-rights): Campaigns focused on gender equality, safety, and representation.

## Community and Discovery
- [Trending petitions](https://www.change.org/petitions?source_location=discover_feed): Feed of petitions currently gaining attention and signatures.
- [Latest petitions](https://www.change.org/petitions?sort_by=recently_created): Recently launched petitions across the platform.
- [Popular petitions](https://www.change.org/petitions?sort_by=most_signed): Petitions with high signature counts and broad support.
- [Local petitions](https://www.change.org/petitions?source_location=homepage_large_button): Discovery path for nearby or locally relevant campaigns.
- [Recommended petitions](https://www.change.org/petitions?source_location=discover): Personalized and topical petition discovery experience.

## For Petition Starters
- [Start a petition](https://www.change.org/start-a-petition): Launch a campaign and publish a petition on the platform.
- [Why people start petitions](https://www.change.org/l/us/en/start-a-petition): Overview of petition-led change and campaign possibilities.
- [Create a petition guide](https://www.change.org/petition-guides/create-a-petition): Best practices for framing demands and telling your story.
- [Share your petition guide](https://www.change.org/petition-guides/share-your-petition): Methods for reaching supporters through social and direct channels.
- [Build momentum guide](https://www.change.org/petition-guides/build-momentum): Strategies for keeping supporters engaged after launch.

## About Change.org
- [About](https://www.change.org/about): Overview of Change.org’s mission, model, and global platform.
- [Careers](https://www.change.org/careers): Open roles and information about working at Change.org.
- [Press](https://www.change.org/press): Media resources, announcements, and company news.
- [Blog](https://www.change.org/blog): Articles about campaigns, platform updates, and civic action.
- [Help Center](https://help.change.org/): Support resources for users, petition starters, and signers.

## Policies and Legal
- [Terms of Service](https://www.change.org/terms): Terms governing use of the Change.org platform.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.change.org/privacy): Details on data collection, use, and privacy choices.
- [Cookie Policy](https://www.change.org/cookies): Information about cookies and tracking technologies used on the site.
- [Community Guidelines](https://www.change.org/policies/community-guidelines): Rules and standards for participation and content on the platform.
- [Accessibility](https://www.change.org/accessibility): Information about accessibility commitments and user support.
